## About Me
I'm currently a Principle Machine Learning Engineer at Seekr. I have a passion for technical issues related to AI Research, Engineering, and Safety.


I believe in [writing as an aid to thinking](http://www.paulgraham.com/essay.html), and [writing as you speak](http://www.paulgraham.com/talk.html). I believe in [slowing down](https://lareviewofbooks.org/article/in-praise-of-slowness/), and that a thing worth doing, is [worth doing badly](http://www.chesterton.org/a-thing-worth-doing/). 

I believe in the pervasiveness of [research debt](http://distill.pub/2017/research-debt/), and in the **invaluable** role of [research distillers](http://distill.pub/2017/research-debt/).

An old draft of an **interactive** Machine Learning with Python+Numpy textbook I was working on is available on my [posts page](posts.qmd), as well as more recent thoughts!
